Title: New Azure SQL Database backup storage metrics are now generally available

Body.Content:
New metrics are now available to monitor Azure SQL Database backup storage consumption in the general purpose and business-critical service tiers:

  • Full backup
  • Differential backup
  • Log backup

Learn more about metrics monitoring with Azure Metrics Explorer.

Get details about Azure SQL Database Metrics.
